quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.goal: Answer multiple-choice questions about Akeanon words.
steps: Read the question at the top of the panel.
Tap the answer you think is right.
If you are right, you will see "Insakto". If not, you will see "Not quite" and the right answer is shown.
The next question opens by itself. The count at the top left shows how far along you are.
tips: You usually need about half of the answers right to pass.
Some questions show a color and ask for its Akeanon word. Others name a word and ask you to tap its color.
In Color Blind Mode, each color also shows its name. Turn it on under Accessibility in Settings.
Right answers raise how well you know a word, and wrong answers lower it. Words you know less come up more often.

phrase_builder.title: Phrase Builder
phrase_builder.goal: Build an Akeanon phrase by putting its words in the right order.
steps: Read the prompt at the top of the panel.
Tap words from the word bank in the order you want them. Each one moves to the answer line.
Tap a word on the answer line to send it back, or tap Clear to start over.
When you have placed enough words, tap Check to see if you are right.
tips: Some words in the bank do not belong in the phrase, so you will not use them all.
The order matters. The right words in the wrong order will not pass.

memory_match.title: Memory Match
memory_match.goal: Match each Akeanon word with its English meaning.
steps: Tap a card to turn it over, then tap a second card.
If the word and meaning match, both cards stay face up.
If they do not match, it counts as a miss and both cards turn back over.
Match every pair to win.
tips: The top of the panel shows your pairs and misses, and how many misses you are allowed.
Going over the miss limit ends the game right away.
Each pair you match raises how well you know that word.

hangman.title: Hangman
hangman.goal: Guess the hidden Akeanon word one letter at a time.
steps: Read the clue, which is the word's English meaning.
Tap a letter, or type it on a keyboard.
A right letter appears in the word. A wrong letter adds a part to the figure.
Fill in the whole word before the figure is finished.
tips: You can usually make 6 wrong guesses.
If you run out of guesses, the word is shown so you can learn it.
Winning raises how well you know the word, and losing lowers it.

crossword.title: Crossword
crossword.goal: Fill the grid with Akeanon words, using their English meanings as clues.
steps: Tap a cell to select its word, or tap a clue in the list.
Tap the same cell again to switch between across and down.
Type with the on-screen keyboard or a physical keyboard. Use Del to fix a letter.
The puzzle ends when every word is right.
tips: Nothing shows whether a word is right until you turn on Check. Then filled words turn green or red.
There is no timer, and you cannot fail.
If this is the newspaper's puzzle, Quit keeps your progress so you can continue that day.

word_search.title: Word Search
word_search.goal: Find the hidden Akeanon words in the letter grid.
steps: Press on the first or last letter of a word.
Drag to the other end of the word. Your selection snaps to a straight line.
Let go to check it. A word from the list counts as found, and any other line flashes red.
Find every word to finish.
tips: The list beside the grid shows the words to find.
There is no timer, and you cannot fail.
If this is the newspaper's puzzle, Quit keeps your progress so you can continue that day.

newspaper.title: The Newspaper
newspaper.goal: Learn a new word each day and solve the daily puzzle.
steps: Read the Word of the Day. Reading it adds the word to your Dictionary.
Check Coming Up to see the next event on the calendar.
Tap Solve to play today's puzzle, which is a crossword or a word search.
Tap Put it down when you are done reading.
tips: You can solve one puzzle per day. Sleep in a bed to start a new day.
If you quit a puzzle, its button changes to Continue so you can finish it that day.
Puzzles are built from words you already know, so you may need to learn more words first.

puzzle.title: Word Puzzle
puzzle.goal: Choose the right word to answer the question or fill in the blank.
steps: Read the sentence or question.
Tap the word you think is right.
If you are wrong, you can try again. The choices move to new positions each time.
When you are right, tap Close to continue.
tips: Some puzzles let you spend a Rose Hint Token to remove a wrong choice.
If you miss a challenge twice, the Dictionary opens so you can look the word up.

npc_menu.title: Talking to People
npc_menu.goal: Chat with people and practice the words you have learned.
steps: Walk up to someone, then tap the button at the bottom right or press E.
Choose Talk to chat with them.
While they talk, tap an underlined word to see what it means.
Choose Review to practice words. You will get a quiz, hangman, or memory match at random.
Choose Goodbye to leave.
tips: Talk to someone again to hear more from them.
Tap the word again, or anywhere else, to close its meaning.
Practice fills the word tier bar at the top of the screen.

map.title: The Map
map.goal: See the places in Aklan and travel to the ones you can reach.
steps: Open the Book and go to the Map tab.
Tap a place on the map.
Choose Mag-adto to go there, or Balik to stay where you are.
tips: Bright places are open. Dim places are not available yet and show Coming Soon.
